title: Deep multi-magnification network segments carcinoma in breast shaved-margin slides
summary: A deep multi-magnification network was applied to whole slide images of breast lumpectomy shaved margins. On a validation set of 408 slides the initial model reached an AUC of 0.941 and 0.968 after fine-tuning; on a testing set of 427 slides AUC was 0.900 and 0.927 and the model had 92% sensitivity and 78% specificity. The four false negatives were small foci of DCIS or well-differentiated invasive carcinoma, and the authors call it a proof-of-principle study.
ai_technology: Deep multi-magnification convolutional neural network for carcinoma segmentation in whole slide images

evidence.tested: Separate validation (408 slides) and testing (427 slides) sets of shave-margin slides.
evidence.unknown: Single-institution retrospective proof of principle; no clinical benefit shown; abstract only; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: The network segmented carcinoma from benign tissue as a possible screening aid for margin assessment.
